field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Every headline, recommendation, and gate from rows.
field_principles.capacity_arm_rows: Per capacity, event, action, occupancy, admission, and exposure.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured execution and task wall time.
field_principles.field_principles: Reason for each capacity, stress, and support field.
field_principles.field_provenance: Upstream event receipts, synthetic stress rules, store actions, and reducers.
field_principles.frozen_stress_manifest: Capacities, schedules, shifts, corruption, horizons, budgets, metrics, and seeds.
field_principles.future_support_rows: Diversity and best-of-k support across budgets and horizons.
field_principles.future_utility_rows: Exact work and validity by family/horizon/capacity/condition.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Exact gate evaluation or blocked_* reason and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: complete_positive, complete_null, disqualified, or blocked_* with gate_check_summary.
field_principles.negative_transfer_rows: Per future unit and stress cell regression.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Complete chronological rows, controller, store, and exact backend.
field_principles.random_seed: All stream, capacity, and evaluation seeds.
field_principles.recommended_capacity: Row-derived capacity recommendation or explicit none.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash over gate, stress manifest, all rows, and attacks.
field_principles.stress_attack_matrix: Growth, bounds, resurrection, corruption, dose, survivor, and aggregation attacks.
field_principles.stress_stream_rows: Every recurrent, shifted, contradictory, stale, and corrupt event.
field_principles.upstream_gate_receipt: Exp6496 path, hash, execution field, expected, and observed value.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True for exact validity and deterministic lifecycle checks only.

medium_bounded.reason: Bounded pool large enough for recurrent and shifted support.

overlarge_unbounded_probe.reason: Admits stale factors to test support reshaping under weak pressure.

zero_frozen.reason: No durable writes. This is the exact frozen baseline.
